newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka tenders to sell Aug 27-28 fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka tenders to sell Aug 27-28 fuel oil.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to sell 19,000 tonnes of 180-cst fuel oil for August lifting, a company official said on Wednesday.

The tender, which offers the 3.5-percent sulphur fuel oil grade for August 27-28 lifting on a free-on-board (fob) Colombo basis, will close on August 12. Bids will be valid for two days, the official said.
In its last tender, CPC sold 20,000 tonnes of 3.5 percent sulphur fuel oil at a discount of $14.75 per tonne to Singapore spot quotes on fob Colombo basis, for July 22-23 lifting.
